reset: i_rstn asynchronous active low, shared with actual frozen top; partial RX/TX discarded; complete table refill required
wire_order: 16-bit header then fixed payload word count; least significant word first; unused high padding must be zero

8000.payload: 1024 signed16 table entries, implicit addresses 0..1023; only while not busy

8001.payload: block_id[3:0]; start accepted only core start_ready; busy or early start consumed and ignored, partial table never launches

8002.payload: cancel, sticky fault until common reset

8100.payload: address[31:0],data[159:32],error[160]; only after complete read request TX

8101.payload: block[3:0],layer[6:4],channel[13:7],group[18:14],window[21:19],weight[213:22],data[461:214],error[462]; only after complete parameter request TX

8102.payload: block[3:0],layer[6:4]; only after complete barrier TX

handshake: All transfer consumers require valid and ready on rising i_clk; no RX payload committed before complete packet; malformed packet, core fault or explicit cancel may abort a pending TX packet and require reset.
TX priority read, parameter, write, barrier; snapshot remains stable under stall; shift only accepted payload beat.
Frozen read_ready/parameter_ready/write_ready pulse only on final accepted TX payload; one gap cycle prevents duplicate capture.
Frozen response valid held throughout APPLY until actual response_ready; unknown, unexpected or padded packets cause shell fault.
Barrier request sent once; host response identity forwarded intact to frozen client; client validates block and layer.
RX and TX independent; host must service each request, providing actual address data/parameter content and truthful write visibility barrier.
No full weight ROM or image cache; mapped result excludes complete package 56 ERAM ROM. Only transport holding registers are added.

cycle_accounting.parameter_request: 3 accepted TX words, capture cycle and final gap
cycle_accounting.parameter_response: 30 accepted RX words plus APPLY wait
cycle_accounting.read_request: 3 accepted TX words, capture cycle and final gap
cycle_accounting.read_response: 12 accepted RX words plus APPLY wait
cycle_accounting.write_export: 5 accepted TX words, capture cycle and final gap
cycle_accounting.barrier: 2 accepted TX words and 2 accepted RX words plus APPLY wait
cycle_accounting.boundary: transport cycle counts are not arithmetic core throughput or full-network FPS
